titleEn: Count Lattice Points Inside a Circle
title: 统计圆内格点数目
summary: 给定若干圆，统计位于至少一个圆内部或边界上的整数坐标点数量。
insight: 坐标和半径范围很小，枚举每个圆包围盒内的整数点，检查平方距离不超过半径平方，并用集合去重。
pitfalls: 多个圆重叠点只计一次
用平方距离避免浮点误差

solutions.title: 枚举圆包围盒格点
solutions.idea: 逐圆添加所有内部格点到坐标集合。
steps: 若 dx²+dy²<=r²，编码坐标加入 Set；返回 size

code.java: class Solution { public int countLatticePoints(int[][] circles){Set<String> points=new HashSet<>();for(int[] circle:circles)for(int x=circle[0]-circle[2];x<=circle[0]+circle[2];x++)for(int y=circle[1]-circle[2];y<=circle[1]+circle[2];y++){int dx=x-circle[0],dy=y-circle[1];if(dx*dx+dy*dy<=circle[2]*circle[2])points.add(x+","+y);}return points.size();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countLatticePoints(circles:Array<IntArray>):Int{val points=HashSet<String>();for(circle in circles)for(x in circle[0]-circle[2]..circle[0]+circle[2])for(y in circle[1]-circle[2]..circle[1]+circle[2]){val dx=x-circle[0];val dy=y-circle[1];if(dx*dx+dy*dy<=circle[2]*circle[2])points.add("$x,$y")};return points.size} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int countLatticePoints(vector<vector<int>>& circles){set<pair<int,int>> points;for(auto& circle:circles)for(int x=circle[0]-circle[2];x<=circle[0]+circle[2];++x)for(int y=circle[1]-circle[2];y<=circle[1]+circle[2];++y){int dx=x-circle[0],dy=y-circle[1];if(dx*dx+dy*dy<=circle[2]*circle[2])points.insert({x,y});}return points.size();} };
